product: The Genie One desktop app for macOS is in Beta
tagline: The Genie One desktop app is now in Beta.
what_it_does: The Genie One desktop app is now in Beta. The native macOS app opens Genie One on your desktop instead of in a browser tab, so business users can chat with data in natural language, work with their threads and documents, and use Genie Agents without a browser. Beta This feature is in Beta.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
